en.g: Discover key features of working life in France.
p: Les 35 heures: the legal standard working week in France is 35 hours ; extra hours are des heures supplémentaires.
Les congés payés: employees have at least five weeks of paid holiday a year ; many leave in August.
La pause déjeuner is often a real break: people eat together, at la cantine or with tickets-restaurant.

La pause déjeuner ist oft eine echte Pause: man isst zusammen, in der cantine oder mit tickets-restaurant.

en.g: Talk about the French school system and compare it with yours.
p: L'école maternelle (from age 3), then l'école élémentaire, then le collège (4 years, ending with le brevet).
Le lycée (3 years) ends with le baccalauréat, le bac. Then l'université or a classe préparatoire.
Les grandes écoles are selective higher-education schools, for example in engineering or business.
